description:
Virtual HID Mini-user-mode-driver for Sony DualShock 3 Controllers


- Motion data can now be exposed through DS4 reports or standard HID Sensor mode, with a configurable coordinate frame and improved Windows sensor compatibility.
- ControlApp adds options for USB output report transport, stick dead zones, and LED control; standard users can save shared settings, and incompatible settings now explain why they’re locked.
- ControlApp no longer requires the ASP.NET runtime to be installed separately.
- Improved HID mode restart reliability and added System log entries and error details for failed controller power-ups.
